description: This file defines the ProspectsViewDetail class, which extends ViewDetail, and manages the display logic for prospect detail views in SuiteCRM. It retrieves related lead information when available and assigns it to the view template.

classes.name: ProspectsViewDetail
classes.description: View class for displaying detailed prospect information, including associated lead data.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class by calling the parent constructor.
